The '''angler's outfit''' is an [[experience-boosting set|experience-boosting clothing set]] that grants 2.5% additional [[experience]] from all [[Fishing]] activities when worn. Equipping any item in the set requires level 34 Fishing. Like all experience-boosting sets, bonus experience is not granted for [[random event]]s, [[experience lamp]]s, or [[Fishing tome|experience tomes]]. Wearing the outfit from level 34 to 99 will save about 317,000 [[experience]], increasing to 4,900,000 experience saved if going all the way to [[200 million experience|200 million]].

Outside of training, the set is necessary for a [[master clue]] step, a [[Dress Like You Mean It|hard combat achievement]], and for access to [[minnow]] fishing. The angler's outfit can be stored in the [[armour case space]] in a [[player-owned house]] and in the [[tackle box]].

The angler's outfit does not boost the Fishing experience gained from doing [[drift net fishing]] or [[deep sea trawling]].
